# Wick Lock

## Working the lock

The Wick lock lifts boats 3.1 metres and takes 9 minutes to fill from empty. The keeper opens the bottom paddles before the top paddles when emptying.

## Tolls

A 60 foot narrowboat pays 2 shillings each way at Wick, written on a numbered ticket.

## Gates

Wick gates are greased at the heel posts every Tuesday.
